args.note: I've written cold-read.md, one section per issue with verdicts. I'd put it down on page 20 (Issue 01), page 37 (Issue 02) and page 60 (Issue 03); nothing lost me in Issue 00. I'd only reach for the next issue after 00 and 01. Biggest problems: the 2099 opening is never connected to the rest of the book; Alpha, the convenor role, the bands and the Houses are never explained; the four makers are hard to tell apart, and Lina Vey and Leona Veyra have almost the same name; TJ and B11 both get the brass ring around the right eye; Ada's tie to Alex and to Leona is never said outright; Tomas gets to Oasis with no explanation. What works best: page 12, the debt dumped on his birthday; Tomas; Ada and Leona on pages 49–50; the dad's recording on page 54; the lever refusal on pages 58–59.
